component.name: 2TI LMailer
component.summary: Native Linux Email, Calendar & Local Ollama AI Agent Suite (30 Days Free Usage)

description.p: 2TI LMailer is a fast, privacy-first desktop groupware and communications suite built for ZorinOS, Debian, and Ubuntu with a native Rust core and Tauri v2 (~28 MB RAM). Includes 30 Days Free Usage during pre-release evaluation with an instant self-service Ed25519 evaluation key from the 2TInteractive License Portal.

ul.li: 30 Days Free Usage with instant self-service Ed25519 evaluation key and seat manager
Unified IMAP/SMTP multi-account inbox with adaptive Dark & Light Theme contrast
Zero-Cloud Local Ollama AI sidebar (localhost:11434) for thread summarization, RAG search, and tone-aware replies
Integrated bidirectional CalDAV calendar and CardDAV contact dossier
Rich HTML signature editor and automated client-side mail rule engine
ArtCraft MCP & CLI workflow bridge for local desktop automation

description.p: Pre-release 1.0.0 with 30 Days Free Usage, adaptive Dark & Light Theme HTML email contrast engine, branded 2TI LMailer identity, Ed25519 offline licensing, and Local Ollama RAG sidebar.
